name: qbeta-modular-resurgence-stokes
description: Modular-resurgence signature probe on the exact Ohtsuki kappa_1..7 ladder: action + beta=3/2 quantum-modular weight trends, Stokes-normalisation candidate grid with entropy accounting, L-function tower blocked at k=7.

data.verdict: scope-(a): the exact kappa-ladder is CONSISTENT within spread with a resurgent action at Vol(4_1)/pi (A_inf rel_dev 0.05243) but NOT with the naive beta = 3/2 modular-weight reading of this ladder normalisation (beta_inf = 0.438539, raw-triple trend ~0.21-0.26; scope-(a) — beta is normalisation-sensitive, so this constrains the as-normalized rung ladder, not the modular-resurgence template itself). The Stokes constant is not identifiable from 7 rungs (best structured-grid candidate sqrt(3/(2pi)) at 0.15% sits below the 1/210 entropy bar but S carries only ~2 stable digits — recorded, not claimed) and the L-function tower is out of reach. The derivation route for A_omega remains the GGM state-integral / 3d-index face (G3).

assertions.name: T1-action-consistent-within-spread
assertions.source: consistency check ONLY — 5 triples + 1 Richardson step; NOT an identification (C1 wording discipline)

assertions.name: T2-beta-vs-modular-3/2
assertions.source: GZ quantum-modularity hbar^{3/2} prefactor => one-instanton loggamma index 3/2 for a modular resurgent series (Fantini-Rella). CAVEAT: beta is normalisation-sensitive — a factorial rescaling of the rung ladder shifts beta by integers/halves; a FAIL here refutes the 3/2 reading of THIS ladder normalisation only (scope-(a)), not the modular-resurgence template.

assertions.name: T3-stokes-no-identification-claimed
assertions.source: structured-grid comparison with entropy accounting; a percent-level best hit against ~210 candidates with ~2 stable digits of S is NOT an identification (PSLQ entropy discipline, PR #1805). Deriving S as a GGM integer count needs the state-integral face, not more rungs.

assertions.name: T4-lfunction-tower-blocked
assertions.source: Fantini-Rella L-function tower test needs the sub-leading Borel singularities (l*A, l >= 2); unresolvable from 7 rungs (dladder witness: singularity NOT resolved at k=21). Recorded as blocked; no claim.
